notes: A greedy `[^\n]*` capture in BASE_RE still swallows later text up to the last `}` on the line, e.g. `*hi*{:} text {braces}` -> `hi} text {braces`. The base commit does the same thing, apart from the `:` attribute, so this PR did not introduce it.
`{::}` and `{: : }` still produce `<h1 :>`. These are not empty lists, so they fall outside the issue.
The new tests fail on the base commit, which prints `<h1 :>` etc., so they do test the change. The `test_ac_fr_*` names are unlike the descriptive names used elsewhere in the file. This is cosmetic.
summary: The PR changes attr_list's BASE_RE so that a list with only a colon and optional spaces, like `{:}` or `{: }`, matches with an empty capture. An empty capture produces no attributes. All three of the issue's examples now render correctly, and non-empty lists still work. I compared the old and new regexes on 24 inputs, and the only change is in empty-list cases. The full suite passes and flake8 is clean. The changelog entry is there, and the new tests fail without the fix.
